messages.subject: Meridian Quarter - building survey findings
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Our building survey of Meridian Quarter is complete. The building is in good order for its age; the main item is the flat roof covering above the 6th floor, with c.5-7 years' remaining life - we'd suggest a modest service charge sinking fund contribution. No structural concerns. Cat-A works to the 2nd floor (Unit 4) are sound. Full report to follow to Halbrook.

Tom Vine
Calderbank Vine
